name: EmbeddedStruct
description: References inside value types: StructHolder.Inner (an InnerStruct field) holds an EmbeddedTarget; a KeyValuePair<string, KvpTarget>[] holds KvpTargets.
notes: EmbeddedTarget is referenced only from the struct embedded in StructHolder; KvpTarget only from the KeyValuePair array. Both must be edges of the containing object, otherwise they look unreachable.
